intentLeaves.intent: IndexedDB schema for project mirroring and write outbox
Online-first mutation wrapper with optimistic UI and outbox fallback
gaps: applyMirror (line 24) does not support all tables found in IDB schema (e.g., pdf_cache_meta, meta are missing from storeMap).
Optimistic flag _pendingSync is set in IDB but not exposed in types/project.ts, so UI components cannot visually distinguish pending vs synced rows easily.

intentLeaves.intent: Reliable outbox drain loop with backoff and causality preservation
gaps: Serial processing (line 36) preserves causality per rowId, but there is no mechanism to handle cross-row dependencies (e.g., creating a pay_item then an annotation that references it).
Conflict detection (baseUpdatedAt) is present in the schema but no resolution logic exists in drainOnce; items that fail with 409 are just marked 'failed' and retried until MAX_ATTEMPTS.

intentLeaves.intent: Snapshotting Supabase project data to IndexedDB for offline access
gaps: mirrorProject is called manually in Index.tsx:128; there is no automatic periodic re-snapshotting if the app stays open for long periods.

intentLeaves.intent: Pivot useProject to use offlineMutate for all write operations
gaps: useProject still accepts supabaseProjectId/userId and performs manual DB updates for calibrations (line 92) and pay_items (line 311) instead of using the uniform offlineMutate path.
Realtime subscription (line 341) does not check the outbox; incoming remote changes could overwrite local optimistic state before it syncs (documented Risk in stream doc).

intentLeaves.intent: PWA Service Worker for asset caching and offline navigation
gaps: Runtime caching for Supabase REST (line 72) uses NetworkFirst with 3s timeout; if the network is extremely slow but not 'offline', the UI will hang for 3s on every fetch.

docDrift.finding: The doc states useProject is 'offline-first pivoted', but several methods (setCalibration, updatePayItems) still call supabase directly rather than using offlineMutate. This is an inconsistent implementation of the pivot.
docDrift.recommendation: Migrate calibrations and pay_items to use offlineMutate to ensure consistent reliability.

docDrift.finding: The doc mentions conflict resolution using baseUpdatedAt. While the field exists in the outbox schema, the sync engine (sync.ts) does not implement any 3-way merge or rebase logic. It simply retries.
docDrift.recommendation: Clarify that conflict resolution is 'detection-only' in the current version.
